# Vitest Gotchas

> Known Vitest patterns that cause silent failures or hard-to-debug errors.

## Entries

- [A dynamic import inside a test body is billed to that test's timeout](dynamic-import-in-test-body.md): `await import()` in an `it()` body charges Vite's resolve+transform of the whole graph to the 5s per-test budget, so a test doing a millisecond of work fails randomly under full-suite load and its calls then poison the next test's spies; static imports are still mocked because `vi.mock` hoists above them, but anything a mock factory closes over must move into `vi.hoisted()`. HIGH.
- [Coverage without an explicit `include` measures only the files your tests import, and rises when you delete one](coverage-include-unset-measures-only-imports.md): `coverage.include` defaults to files loaded during the run, so untested files leave the denominator entirely and the percentage goes UP when you drop a module from the import graph; one repo read 84% over 91 of 284 files and 28% once `include` was set. With no `thresholds` block the run cannot fail either, and if CI calls a script without `--coverage` nothing is enforced at all. `all: true` is the removed Vitest 1.x mechanism and does not fix it. HIGH.
